instructions.en: Use your finger to trace the letter. Follow the arrow from start to finish.

incorrect: Try to follow the line more closely.
feedback.hint: Start at the green dot and follow the grey path.

designNote: Modul ini sengaja guna huruf & perkataan konteks yang SAMA seperti Modul 1 (Bunyi & Padan) di mana boleh — supaya wujud lingkaran pembelajaran: dengar bunyi -> kenal huruf -> tulis huruf, dan imageAsset terus reuse daripada Modul 1. SATU huruf baharu ditambah ('e' - Eye) untuk lengkapkan asas konsonan-vokal; imageAsset 'eye_icon' perlu ditambah (rujuk asset brief).

items.strokeHint: Start at the top. Draw a straight line straight down.
Start at the top. Straight line down, then a short line across the middle.
Curve at the top, straight line down, then a short line across the middle.
Tall line down, then a hump over to the right without lifting your finger.
Short line down, then a small hump over to the right.
Zigzag down-up-down-up, like two small V shapes joined.
Short line down, then two humps over to the right, one after another.
Draw a circle first, then a tall straight line down on the right side.
Tall straight line down first, then a curve to make a circle at the bottom.
Line down below the baseline first, then a curve to make a circle at the top.
Short line down, then a small curve at the top only, like a little flag.
One smooth curvy line — curve left, then curve right, like a snake.
Start near the top and curve all the way around, like a backwards C — don't close the circle.
One smooth circle, start at the top and come all the way back round.
Start in the middle, small line across, then curve around like an almost-circle.
Draw a circle first, then a curved tail that dips below the baseline.

validationLogic.note: Kesukaran teknikal utama modul ini bukan 'betul/salah' seperti Modul 1-2, tetapi ACCURACY SCORE (peratus lintasan yang menepati laluan huruf).

accuracyThresholds.pass: ≥70% lintasan menepati laluan (garis panduan longgar, bukan ketat, sesuai motor skill Tahun 1)
accuracyThresholds.hintTrigger: Jika 2 percubaan berturut-turut <50%, tunjuk animasi 'contoh tulisan' sekali sebelum percubaan seterusnya
